scope: Published source-only subset of current artifact-backed Node tests. Narrower than the full local native-evidence suite.
policy: All 152 current test files are published byte-identical to the workspace. Twenty-two existing files were explicitly migrated for the Tanya catalog delta; no callbacks or assertions were removed. No private fixture, recovered artifact, historical preimage, or substitute baseline is fabricated. Whole-file exclusions occur only for dependencies read at module initialization. Other omissions use exact callback names. Mixed evidence/implementation callbacks are omitted in full and do not count as implementation coverage.
